summary: 15 Java files under java.generated.project/src/main/java/lre/ covering all 51 LRE requirements; project compiles. Five items need requirement-owner review.

issues.title: no-dynamic-obstacle default contradicts itself (LRE-DM5 vs LRE-OP5)
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 says the field accessors return zero when no obstacle exists; LRE-OP5 says the Sensor returns 'zero-velocity and large-distance defaults'. Reconstructing the relative position from the zeroed accessors makes cda = 0, so the LRE would enter CAM whenever no dynamic obstacle exists.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm cda falls back to the large horizontal distance (hdist(cdyn)) rather than to the zeroed field accessors.

issues.title: CPA formula and its degenerate case were not specified
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 names cda and tcpa but gives no formula. Standard constant-velocity CPA used: tcpa = -(r.v)/|v|^2, cda = sqrt(|r|^2 - (r.v)^2/|v|^2), with |v|^2 floored by 1.0e-9 so a non-closing pair yields tcpa = 0 and cda = present horizontal distance.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the CPA is horizontal-plane only and that a non-closing pair should yield tcpa = 0.

issues.title: CAM issues no evasive command
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 says the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres in CAM, but LRE-DM7 allows only advVel and advHdng and no requirement gives either a value for CAM entry. Nothing is emitted on entry to CAM.
issues.fix_directive: Supply the advised velocity and/or heading for CAM entry, or confirm CAM entry is silent.

issues.title: -1 sentinel for cstc/cdyn under the extractor's int -> nat mapping
issues.raw: LRE-DM5/Var5/Var6 specify -1 as the 'no obstacle' index, but CLAUDE.md records that every Java int maps to RoboChart nat unconditionally. The sentinel is kept in Java; no controller predicate tests it, because the Sensor returns a large distance for any index it does not hold.
issues.fix_directive: No code change proposed. If the formal model must represent 'no obstacle', the requirement needs a non-negative encoding.

issues.title: where the LRE-Var* variables live
issues.raw: LRE-Var1..8 say the controller maintains each variable while the operations compute them. hvel, vvel, vel, cstc, cdyn, cda and tcpa are controller fields refreshed at the head of step(). inOpez is held by CheckOPEZ instead, because LRE-GP1 asks for a named predicate inOpez in step() and a same-named controller field would shadow it.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm this split; making inOpez a controller field and renaming the predicate is equally valid and changes which extracted interface the variable lands in.
